contact_name.value: Billy T. Y. Lee, P. E.

services.value: Planning, design, and consulting services for buildings, campuses, and infrastructure assets, including engineering design and management of mechanical, electrical, civil, water, wastewater, environmental, and energy planning and design. Services also include oil & gas facility engineering (commissioning, compressor stations, metering and regulation, and processing/refinery), with related engineering tasks such as PSV studies and capacity review, pipeline hydraulics/analysis, and facility engineering services.
